## Professional summary

Computational linguist working at the intersection of empirical linguistics and language model evaluation. Studies how linguistic structure shapes cognition and affect, using corpus-based quantitative analysis and large controlled experiments, and turns pragmatic, emotional and cultural nuance into measurable signals that show where model language aligns with human language and where it diverges. Owns research end to end, from experimental design and platform engineering to statistics and sole-authored publication (PANDORA @ EMNLP 2026). Research on modal particles and emoji in translation was featured by DeepL in its DeepL Bridges launch materials, alongside hands-on RLHF data work for Korean LLM alignment. Works across Korean, English and German, with the longer aim of alignment methods that hold across languages, not just within one.

## Core competencies

- AI and product strategy: language model alignment, RLHF annotation, human-in-the-loop evaluation, benchmark design, cross-functional stakeholder management
- Tools and frameworks: statistical modeling (R/Python), cloud resource orchestration (GCP), empirical experimental design
- Languages: Korean (native), English (C1 / professional), German (C1 / professional)

## Publications and key research

- Park, K. (2026). The Grue Divide: When Cognitive Accuracy Doesn't Predict Affective Alignment. Poster, PANDORA @ EMNLP 2026. Sole author; developed from the author's MA thesis. Paper: https://aclanthology.org/2026.pandora-1.2 · Experiment platform: https://bakeyeon.github.io/colorfish/
- MA thesis: "Can the Use of Derivatives Affect Cognition? A Large-Scale Empirical Study on Morphological Derivation and the Korean Blue-Green Spectrum." University of Göttingen, 2026. https://publications.goettingen-research-online.de/handle/2/182236
- Public-facing research writing: "Can We Translate Our Sentiments?" (GoPenAI on Medium, 2026). An accessible piece revisiting 2024 term-paper research on cross-lingual emotional nuance and perceptual color cognition, featured in DeepL Bridges launch materials (https://www.deepl.com/en/blog/connecting-insights-deepl-bridges). https://blog.gopenai.com/can-we-translate-our-sentiments-140c55822ead

## Research and product framework projects

### Large-scale cognitive data architecture (MA thesis project and PANDORA paper)
- Designed, built and deployed a web-based empirical experiment platform, collecting 9,534 analyzed trials from 1,159 participants (about 2,200 recruited); formulated statistical models and data pipelines to quantify morphological cognition effects.

### Light Verbs, Heavy Meaning? (MA seminar term paper, Göttingen)
- Tested Polinsky and Magyar's (2020) informativity account of head-final lexicons on Korean simplex verbs vs. root+hata constructions via dictionary sense counts, embedding self-similarity (KLUE-BERT, KcBERT, Vertex AI) and corpus frequency. The predicted asymmetry held in 58% of 38 conditions and was item-driven rather than structurally deterministic. https://github.com/bakeyeon/light-verbs-heavy-meaning

### Modal particles, emojis and sentiment translation (MA term paper series, HHU Düsseldorf)
- Survey study finding a significant correlation between the emotional scores of German modal particles and expressive emojis, extended with a benchmark of FastText, Hugging Face and BERT sentiment models. https://github.com/bakeyeon/Modalparticles_Emojis · https://github.com/bakeyeon/modalparticles_sentiment_analysis
- Built "Sentiment Translator", a Gemini/AI Studio prototype visualizing cross-lingual sentiment shifts via an interactive emoji-based emotion map. https://github.com/bakeyeon/sentiment_translator

## Work experience

### Freelance Linguistic Editor, AI Alignment (Korean/English): DeepL SE, Language Data Team, Research (Nov 2024 – present, remote)
- Human-in-the-loop RLHF alignment: preference ranking, minimal-error editing and full rewriting to build gold-standard datasets for Korean LLM alignment. Formulated structural linguistic rationales and proposed new decision criteria for cross-lingual semantic ambiguity (KO–EN).
- Part of DeepL Bridges Early Access; research on linguistic nuance featured in official platform launch materials, including work on modal-particle sentiment and emoji-mediated translation, and the survey platform built for the "Grue Divide" paper (poster, PANDORA workshop, EMNLP 2026).

### Freelance Localization QA Specialist and Translator: CCJK Technologies (Marstranslation) / SUCCESSGLO PTE LTD (May 2022 – Nov 2026, remote)
- Delivered linguistic QA, translation, voice-over (tech/legal/compliance) and full/technical MTPE across Korean–English and German–Korean pairs; served as final QA on 100+ tasks, including Korean voiceover localization for English IVR systems.
- Handled UI-based length-overflow issues in German–English–Korean localization for automotive infotainment clients, and provided structured peer review for junior linguists, working with Trados and proprietary QA tools.

### Head of Strategic Planning and Brand Strategist: Minor to Winner, social venture (May 2016 – Jul 2016, on-site)
- Led strategic planning as one of two core team members alongside the founder during early-stage company building, with cross-functional ownership of operations, branding and HR.
- Scaled the team by onboarding 8 new members within the 3-month mandate.
- Co-led rebranding initiatives for regional industry promotion.
- Secured government grant funding and led contract negotiations with public and private stakeholders.

### Performance Marketing Planner (AE), internship: 9 Fruits Media (Dec 2015 – May 2016, on-site)
- Owned budget planning and allocation for multi-channel growth campaigns on a major TV home-shopping platform, directing creative-team briefs and deliverables end to end.
- Drove measurable conversion growth via data-driven content optimization and cross-platform tracking: Facebook purchase-link clicks +173% in 2 months (829 → 2,265); Kakao conversion clicks +516% in 6 months (25 → 154); Naver link clicks +408% in 6 months (123 → 625).
- Managed publication workflows and authored monthly performance and competitor-analysis reports for client stakeholders.
- Led client-facing communication and marketing analytics.
